bug_semantics: An attacker-controlled imported Typebot could contain a Script block whose code was returned as a client-side action and compiled and executed by @typebot.io/js in the preview page with AsyncFunction/Function. Preview ran under the victim's authenticated app.typebot.io browser context, so the script could issue same-origin credentialed requests. It could enumerate the victim's credentials and call credentials.getCredentials to obtain decrypted OpenAI keys, Google tokens, SMTP secrets, and other stored credential data, then exfiltrate them. The user-scoped getCredentials branch did bind the record to user.id; the workspace branch checked that the victim could write the supplied workspace but fetched the credential by id without additionally binding it to that workspace. Either way, arbitrary script in the victim's session defeated the intended principal boundary. The missing control was distrust/sandboxing of imported client-executed code during privileged preview, not JavaScript syntax validation.
flaw_origin: The affected @typebot.io/js executor lineage was created by pull-request member commit 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894. It added packages/js/src/features/blocks/logic/code/utils/executeCode.ts with Function(...args, content) and invoked it for server-supplied code actions, with no import provenance, preview trust decision, consent, or sandbox. GitHub squash commit 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc has the same parent and tree, so it is only the landed aggregate object, not the smallest recoverable commit object. Later commits renamed Code to Script, added async support, moved the package/path, and exposed an Execute on client toggle defaulting true; those preserved or expanded the already-present sink rather than introducing it. A still earlier legacy bot-engine Code-step executor existed in e3e07ddd4dbae6e7b893a0d6be9f12b80d1a6c9c, but it is not the affected @typebot.io/js file/package lineage: 3487850b created the distinct V2 embed package implementation that was subsequently released as @typebot.io/js.
ai_marker:
No AI marker on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894` shows human author and committer `Baptiste Arnaud <contact@baptiste-arnaud.fr>` and message `:alembic: Implement bot v2 MVP

Closes #190`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer. The GitHub API commit object for the sole PR #194 member reports the same human identity and message.
evidence: Advisory boundary: the assigned GHSA-4xc5-wfwc-jw47/CVE-2025-65098 record names @typebot.io/js, range `< 0.9.15`, first patched 0.9.15, the vulnerable path packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/logic/script/executeScript.ts, and direct commit a68f0c91790af8f52f17557f4aa202e966e7e579.

Affected sink at the fix parent: `git show a5cf298cc8043e95c6988779be8c9e0e495e0378:packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/logic/script/executeScript.ts` shows executeScript constructing `AsyncFunction(...args.map(id), parseContent(content))` and awaiting it in the browser, with no provenance or preview restriction. `git show a5cf298...:packages/bot-engine/src/blocks/logic/script/executeScript.ts` shows client-executed script content being emitted as `scriptToExecute` without an unsafe flag.

Credential impact at the fix parent: `git show a5cf298cc8043e95c6988779be8c9e0e495e0378:apps/builder/src/features/credentials/api/getCredentials.ts` shows authenticated plaintext decryption and return. The user branch queries `{id: input.credentialsId, userId: user.id}`. The workspace branch authorizes the supplied workspace with `isWriteWorkspaceForbidden`, but then queries credentials with `{id: input.credentialsId}` rather than `{id, workspaceId}`. Thus the advisory's broad phrase 'without ownership verification' is exact for the workspace credential lookup but not for the user branch; the malicious preview still runs as the victim and can read the victim's own secrets in both scopes.

Lineage cross-check: `git log --follow -- packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/logic/script/executeScript.ts` reaches landed commit 1a3869ae6d9fa92fc71ef9d981bfffb8e4ee4ecc. `git log -L 8,12:packages/embeds/js/src/features/blocks/logic/script/executeScript.ts a5cf298cc8043e95c6988779be8c9e0e495e0378` traces the client compiler/call through 96af708b, 10750f54, and 036b407a to 1a3869a. `git log -S'Function(step.options.content)()' -- packages/bot-engine/src/services/logic.ts` separately confirms the legacy e3e07ddd line and prevents confusing the old engine with this affected package lineage.

Squash decomposition: `https://api.github.com/repos/baptisteArno/typebot.io/pulls/194/commits` returns exactly one member, 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894, parent e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6. `git show -s --format='%H %T %P' 3487850b... 1a3869a...` yields the same tree 1c7360226886e227373c9affe2a374c1fbe7c750 and same parent for both objects. Therefore 3487850b is the recoverable direct commit and 1a3869a is the GitHub-landed squash object.

BIC change and parent absence: `git show 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 -- packages/js/src/features/blocks/logic/code/utils/executeCode.ts packages/js/src/utils/executeLogic.ts` adds the new executor, `Function(...args.map((arg) => arg.id), content)`, and dispatches `logic.codeToExecute` to it. `git cat-file -e e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6:packages/js/src/features/blocks/logic/code/utils/executeCode.ts` fails because the parent has no such path; the package and affected executor are introduced by the BIC.

Why later candidates are not the BIC: 918dffb4bc7a18da41862b90288bda8fe59246ae only changed the existing runner to permit await; 42008f8c18430e6194d9552b93c8ec04ec484d6e added `isExecutedOnClient` and set its default to true while retaining the prior client path; path-changing commits such as cbc8194f19396ed8f8b3ea05d75223beeab42c3c and 10750f54d10a0d96c77371a7f244fad94471abc0 are reorganizations. The exploit does not require top-level await, so async support is not causal.

Fix behavior: `git show a68f0c91790af8f52f17557f4aa202e966e7e579` adds `enableSafetyFlags` to file import, marks imported client Script/SetVariable blocks `isUnsafe`, propagates that flag to client actions, adds `isPreview` context, and changes executeScript so preview plus unsafe code runs through runUserCodeInWorker. The added worker forces fetch credentials to `omit` and disables XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, and nested workers. Non-imported/non-preview code retains normal execution, making this a direct trust-boundary fix rather than removal of the advertised scripting feature. The same commit bumps packages/embeds/js/package.json from 0.9.14 to 0.9.15.

Release boundary: `git rev-parse js-v0.9.14^{} js-v0.9.15^{}` resolves to c823aba3db7eb213dd762b4dc015a3a06e8b7925 and 150cbc682cc6a9dc66d19b3048318546d23086a6 respectively. a68f0c9 is not an ancestor of js-v0.9.14 but is the immediate parent of the js-v0.9.15 release commit 150cbc68. `git rev-parse js-v0.0.1^{}` resolves to ef9170dcb664705270c6859de16d92ea7c8071b7, which contains 3487850b's landed equivalent and declares @typebot.io/js version 0.0.1; therefore every released package version through 0.9.14 inherited the sink and 0.9.15 is the first fixed package release.

BIC-only AI check: `git cat-file -p 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894` prints tree 1c736022..., parent e55823e..., human author/committer Baptiste Arnaud, and only the two-line conventional message. No AI attribution appears in the commit object. No AI evidence from the fix, PR prose, branches, or later commits was used.
reasoning: The vulnerability is a confused-trust execution chain: Typebot intentionally supports script blocks, but the affected embed package did not distinguish trusted author code from code arriving in an imported bot when a logged-in victim previewed it. The BIC must therefore be the first recoverable commit object that created the affected @typebot.io/js client executor, not the later async conversion, option label, path migrations, or the security patch. Mainline commit 1a3869a is a squash landing; PR #194 exposes its sole direct member 3487850b with the identical tree and parent, so decomposition is exact. The parent lacks the new package executor, satisfying direct parent absence. The advisory-linked a68f0c9 commit directly closes the preview/import trust gap, bumps 0.9.14 to 0.9.15, and is contained first by js-v0.9.15. Finally, the BIC commit object contains only a human identity and no AI marker. Under the required BIC-only rule, this is conclusively NOT_AI even though the commit is large and irrespective of any evidence outside that commit object.
